_about: Counted figures that are CORRECT but legitimately differ from the live store, read by scripts/check-surface-numbers.mjs. Every entry needs a reason a stranger could verify. An entry is a statement about history or a frozen release — never a way to silence a stale live number (fix those at the source: <!--live:KEY--> markers, data-live tokens, sync-doc-counts.py, omnarai-home/sync-counts.mjs). `surface` is a substring of the surface path (hf:/… for Hugging Face cards, front:/… for omnarai.org).
